speaker: Zrix
text: You found the glyph. Good. Now the armory can hear you.

speaker: Zrix
text: A named session is a permanent address. Once opened, it stays alive until you kill it — even after you detach and leave.

speaker: Zrix
text: Open a named Rift to armory. Bring back the bracket cannon before the overflow reaches the village core.

speaker: Zrix
text: Type: tmux new -s armory — give it a name that means something. The armory will answer.
